app.name: VIRASAT
app.tagline: Heritage compliance evidence for the Jaipur Walled City
app.footer: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Boundary: UNESCO WHC 1605 · Buildings: Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (CC BY 4.0) · Imagery: Copernicus Sentinel-2
app.recommendation: Every output is a recommendation to a named officer. Nothing here is sent to a citizen or an enforcement system.

login.title: Officer sign-in
login.note: Access is limited to Jaipur Nagar Nigam / JDA heritage officers.

queue.title: Review queue
queue.empty: Nothing to review. The weekly batch has not produced new findings.
queue.keys: Keys: J/K move · A approve · R reject · E escalate

change.slider: Drag to compare before and after
change.noFindings: The assessor returned no supported finding. An empty list is a valid answer.
change.needsRewrite: Two revisions failed verification. Read the notes before acting.
change.uncalibrated: not calibrated — presence score from Open Buildings
change.reason: Reason for rejection (required — it feeds the retraining set)

audit.title: Audit log
audit.append: Append-only. UPDATE and DELETE are rejected by the database.

landing.sub: VIRASAT detects built-form change inside the inscribed property and its buffer, checks each change against the Heritage Regulation, and drafts a citation-backed assessment for a human officer.
landing.ghosts: Demolished structures remain as ghosts. The absence is the point.
landing.reduced: Reduced motion: use the slider to move through the years.
